     which is whether booking this makes them look good. It was on five pages

props.html: It’s the one booking on the roster that grows through the night: one setup, one sound check, and the same voice from the first drink to the last song.
At quartet size it’s a dance band, the full rhythm section behind one voice, with keys or a second guitar on top, playing a covers set built for a floor.

rows.text: The quartet is the size for a company party with a dance floor, in a downtown Denver ballroom or an office of your own.
At duo size the same songs sit under the conversation, which is what a client dinner or a member evening asks for. An hour on its own is a real booking.
A milestone birthday or an anniversary with a dinner to talk through and a dance floor after it, on one booking. The trio is the size for a party that wants a floor in a smaller space.
The duo puts a voice in the hour after the ceremony, and if the reception wants a dance floor later, the same act grows into it.

props.html: How the music sits around speeches and a program is planned with the run of show. What live music costs across Colorado, size by size, is set out in the cost guide.

items.a: Covers, fronted by one voice and often built live with a looper, from the Beatles and Bob Marley to the songs of the last twenty years. He also plays his own singer-songwriter material when you want it. He's a Denver musician booked through Signet Artists as a duo, a trio or a quartet.

As a duo under dinner, it sits at the level of the conversation. At quartet size on the dance floor, it's as loud as a band at a good party. The band moves between the two on cue and sets the level to the space, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number.
No. Nobody changes costume, there's no choreography and there's no host segment. The band plays, reads the floor and plays the next song.

items.q: Can we ask for a song?
items.a: Yes. One learned song of your choosing comes with every booking, often the first dance at a wedding, and if the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night.
